# Media fixtures

Small test media with known content, generated by
`scripts/gen-media-fixtures.sh` (macOS or Linux; needs espeak-ng, ffmpeg and
Python with Pillow). No third-party recordings or images, no personal data.

| File | What | Content |
|------|------|---------|
| `text.png` | PNG 560x140 | "Cassette fixture" / "invoice 4821", drawn with Pillow's bundled Aileron font (CC0) |
| `speech.wav` | 16 kHz mono WAV, 8.4 s | two synthetic voices (espeak-ng `en-us+f3`, `en-us+m3`) reading two lines |
| `clip.mp4` | H.264 + AAC, 320x180, 4 fps, 8.4 s | text cards "Scene 1 / code 7305" then "Scene 2 / code 1960", with the speech as audio |
| `speech.srt`, `speech.vtt` | captions | the two spoken lines with timestamps |

## Licences

- Speech audio (`speech.wav` and the `clip.mp4` audio track): synthesised
  with eSpeak NG, which plays back stored phoneme samples. The audio may
  therefore contain fragments of eSpeak NG's GPL-3.0-or-later data, and is
  distributed under terms compatible with it (this repository is
  AGPL-3.0). No CC0 claim is made for it.
- Image (`text.png`), the video frames of `clip.mp4` and the captions
  (`speech.srt`, `speech.vtt`): drawn or written by the generator script
  from original text; CC0 1.0.
